verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents CDP-level interoperability: `localBrowser.connect` attaches to any running Chromium by URL. It also says you can 'use page methods you already know' and 'familiar APIs', which suggests existing Playwright-style page code can run with little rewriting. However, the CDP attach goes the other way: Stagehand connects to your browser, not your existing Playwright/Puppeteer scripts connecting to Stagehand's or Browserbase's browsers. Missing for 10: documented connection of existing Playwright/Puppeteer clients to Stagehand-managed browsers (e.g., an exposed CDP endpoint), explicit Puppeteer compatibility, migration docs, independent corroboration.
